scope: Actual Firefox Open/Save and current AppImage chooser on private X11/bus/profile; private portal definition projection; production installation setup was tested separately

firefox_scope.purpose: Correct real application attribution; inner Firefox retains only explicitly selected private session/environment values

open_save: Actual native Open and Save dialogs both owned by the delivered AppImage chooser; browser displays chosen document and writes exact saved bytes
identity_scope: Parent runner verifies real Firefox attribution independently from the frontend log; this controller verifies Open/Save bytes and chooser ownership.
identity_limit: Ordinary installed Firefox identity accepted through its desktop-entry systemd scope; this is not installed Flatpak-browser acceptance.
